summary.ru: Багамские Острова, Багамы, официальное название — Содружество Багамских Островов — государство на одноимённых островах, к северу от Карибского моря и Кубы, к юго-востоку от полуострова Флорида.
summary.en: The Bahamas, officially the Commonwealth of The Bahamas, is an archipelagic country in the Caribbean located within the Lucayan Archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean. The country comprises 700 islands, and more than 2,500 cays in the Atlantic Ocean, located north of Cuba and north-west of the island of Hispaniola (split between the Dominican Republic and Haiti) and the Turks and Caicos Islands, southeast of the US state of Florida and east of the Florida Keys. The capital and largest city is Nassau on the island of New Providence.
